column1: # site rule (a) and the CSP for the intake endpoint (ADR-0006 part 9; M5b
# PR 3), one row per branch and per variant, on a copy of render/pass-intake
# (the real built pages, no built pins) through site_intake_runner in
# tools/selftest.sh. Columns: name, file, find, replace, expect (PASS, or a
# text the findings must hold), then optional further find and replace
# pairs. File @csp sets params.csp in hugo.toml and the content of every
# page's CSP meta to replace (find is -); @css and @js append replace to
# the built stylesheet and copy script. One csp-intake/<directive> row per
# member of CSP_DIRECTIVES but form-action (site-intake/coverage takes the
# set from the code) puts the intake origin in that directive.
